verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Dynadot serves a live llms.txt file (HTTP 200) with structured content describing the company for AI agents, and Dynadot also documents an official MCP server for agent-based domain management, directly matching the story of pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: fuller excerpt of llms.txt content showing structured navigation for agents, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation that agents successfully consume it.
